plugins.name: design-helper
plugins.description: Settle design decisions by eye, one at a time: every candidate is drawn on your real screens side by side and you pick. Six skills: values and layouts (applied to code), a design system, syncing it to code, feature UX flows, icon sets and logos, and library motion (GSAP, Motion).
